candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (Uradni list RS) - enarocanje.si
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory national publication point where every Slovenian contracting authority, including all obcine, mestne obcine, javna podjetja (LPP, Marprom, LPT) and javni zavodi (hospitals), must publish contract notices, tender documentation and award notices under ZJN-3. Below-EU-threshold municipal payments/ticketing procurements appear here and often ONLY here (not on TED).
candidates.access_status: public, no login for reading notices
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled search-result scraping by CPV code and Slovene keyword (plačilni terminal, POS, kartični sistem, vozovnice, parkomat, bančne storitve) plus per-notice form pages of pattern /Obrazci/?id_obrazec=NNNNNN; check for an eForms/OJS-aligned structured export before scraping HTML.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search + snowballing from municipal procurement pages
queries_used: Portal javnih naročil enarocanje.si objave naročnik občina
Mestna občina Ljubljana javna naročila razpisi objave

candidates.source_name: eJN - Sistem elektronskega javnega naročanja (ejn.gov.si)
candidates.why_relevant: State e-procurement platform where bids are actually submitted; the 'Aktualna javna naročila' list exposes live procurements with per-case detail pages (aktualno_jnc_podrobno.xhtml?zadevaId=NNNNN) including municipal and hospital buyers. Complements enarocanje.si with deadline/lot detail.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the aktualna_javna_narocila listing page and iterate zadevaId detail pages; JSF/XHTML session state may require a stateful HTTP client rather than plain GET.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search, appeared repeatedly as buyer-side link from obcina and hospital pages
queries_used: Mestna občina Maribor javna naročila portal
UKC Ljubljana javna naročila

candidates.source_name: Mestna obcina Ljubljana - Razpisi, razgrnitve in javne objave
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenia's largest municipal buyer. Publishes its own calls, awards, ordinances (odredbe) on parking zones and payment, and annual lists of awarded contracts; the parking/ticketing policy documents here signal upcoming payment-acceptance procurement by MOL and its holding companies.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the razpisi listing plus /sl/mestni-servis/razpisi-razgrnitve-in-javne-objave and the informacije-javnega-znacaja catalogue; also fetch linked PDFs under /assets/Uploads/.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search on seed query
queries_used: Mestna občina Ljubljana javna naročila razpisi objave
občina javno naročilo brezstično plačevanje parkirnine razpis

candidates.source_name: Mestna obcina Maribor - Javni razpisi in objave / Sluzba za javna narocila
candidates.why_relevant: Second-largest municipal buyer; runs centralised procurement for all city-administration bodies via its Sluzba za javna narocila, and owns Marprom which deployed open-loop Visa/Mastercard acceptance on buses in Dec 2024 - a directly payments-relevant buyer relationship.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape /javni-razpisi/ and /kategorija_razpis/javni-razpis/ category feeds plus the katalog-informacij-javnega-znacaja objave-in-razpisi page.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search
queries_used: Mestna občina Maribor javna naročila portal

candidates.source_name: Mestna obcina Celje - Razpisi in javne objave / Javna narocila
candidates.why_relevant: Third city municipality in the cell; maintains both a news-style razpisi section and a dedicated javna-narocila page plus a separate e-forms portal (vloge.celje.si/razpisi) carrying calls, auctions and decisions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape both moc.celje.si/javna-narocila and vloge.celje.si/razpisi; watch for duplication between the two.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search
queries_used: Mestna občina Celje javna naročila

candidates.source_name: Mestna obcina Kranj - Javni razpisi, narocila, razgrnitve (incl. annual awarded-contract lists)
candidates.why_relevant: Kranj publishes a well-structured set of sub-pages: live javna narocila, javni razpisi, results (rezultati), archive, and - most valuable for market sizing - 'letni seznami oddanih javnih narocil' listing every contract >=10,000 EUR ex-VAT below threshold with supplier name and value. That low-value band is exactly where POS terminals, card readers and small payment integrations sit.
candidates.legal_status: official municipal publication; ZJN-3 Art. 21 mandated annual list
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the five sub-pages; parse the annual seznam oddanih javnih narocil spreadsheets/PDFs for supplier-value pairs. Use this page structure as the template for probing the same ZJN-3 annual list on all other obcine.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search
queries_used: Mestna občina Kranj javna naročila razpisi

candidates.source_name: Mestna obcina Koper - Informacije javnega znacaja / obcinska uprava
candidates.why_relevant: Coastal city municipality with bilingual (sl/it) administration; its Sekretariat obcinske uprave handles general affairs and public procurement. Publishes calls and the mandated public-information catalogue. Some of its calls also route through Uradni list RS rather than the municipal site.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape informacije-javnega-znacaja and vloge-obrazci-in-predpisi; supplement with an enarocanje.si buyer-name query for 'MESTNA OBCINA KOPER' since the site's own procurement index was not clearly located.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search
queries_used: Mestna občina Koper javna naročila

candidates.source_name: Drzavna revizijska komisija (DKOM) - Iskalnik po odlocitvah
candidates.why_relevant: Highest-value indirect source in this cell. Review decisions expose the technical specifications, bidder identities, prices and disqualification grounds of contested municipal payment/ticketing procurements that the notices themselves summarise thinly. Confirmed example: case 018-027/2024 against JP Ljubljanska parkirisca in trznice over 'Nakup parkirnih sistemov' (purchase of parking systems).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-query the decision search for naročnik names (obcina, LPP, Marprom, LPT, bolnisnica) and subject terms (plačilni, kartični, parkirni sistem, terminali); also poll 'Zadeve v odlocanju' for cases still pending, which is a forward-looking signal.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search; snowballed from LPT parking-systems query
queries_used: Državna revizijska komisija DKOM odločitve javna naročila iskalnik
Ljubljanska parkirišča in tržnice javna naročila razpis parkomati plačilni sistem

candidates.source_name: ERAR (Komisija za preprecevanje korupcije) - public-sector transaction database
candidates.why_relevant: Shows actual money flows from every obcina, javno podjetje and javni zavod to named private suppliers - i.e. who really got paid for terminals, ticketing, parking systems and banking services, including contracts below the notice threshold that never appear on enarocanje.si. Rebuilt in 2023 with better filtering and data export.
candidates.legal_status: statutory publication under ZIntPK Art. 75.a/75.b; also mirrored as an open dataset on podatki.gov.si
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OPSI open dataset / bulk export over UI scraping; query payer=obcina/javno podjetje against payee=payments vendors to build a supplier-share view.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search on transparency portals
queries_used: ERAR erar.si transakcije javnega sektorja občine plačila iskalnik

candidates.source_name: JP Ljubljanski potniski promet (LPP) / Javni holding Ljubljana - Urbana card system
candidates.why_relevant: Operator of the Urbana closed-loop city card and its mobile app; part of Javni holding Ljubljana, which procures jointly for LPP, LPT, Energetika and VOKA-Snaga. Urbana spans transit, parking, library - the widest municipal payment-acceptance estate in Slovenia and the single most important non-central buyer for card/ticketing systems.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor lpp.si and jhl.si news/procurement sections for system-change announcements; cross-reference the buyer names 'JAVNI HOLDING LJUBLJANA', 'JAVNO PODJETJE LJUBLJANSKI POTNISKI PROMET' on enarocanje.si and DKOM. Terms of service pages (urbana.jhl.si/home/help) reveal scheme/acceptance changes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search + snowball from MOL
queries_used: Javni holding Ljubljana LPP javno naročilo Urbana kartica sistem vozovnice

candidates.source_name: JP Ljubljanska parkirisca in trznice (LPT) - parking payment estate
candidates.why_relevant: Operates Ljubljana's parkomati, urbanomati and garages accepting Urbana, cash, payment cards and Valu mobile wallet. Confirmed to have run a 'Nakup parkirnih sistemov' procurement that reached DKOM in 2024 - a live, verifiable payments-hardware buyer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the parking-information pages for accepted-payment-method changes (a leading indicator of terminal refresh), and track the LPT buyer name on enarocanje.si and DKOM.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search; snowballed to DKOM case
queries_used: Ljubljanska parkirišča in tržnice javna naročila razpis parkomati plačilni sistem

candidates.source_name: Javno podjetje Marprom (Maribor city transport)
candidates.why_relevant: Maribor's municipal transport operator; since 9 Dec 2024 accepts open-loop Visa/Mastercard plus Google/Apple/Garmin Pay on new on-bus validators, and runs an Urbana-style contactless card covering buses and the Pohorje cable car. A concrete, recent example of the ticketing-to-open-loop transition this cell tracks, and a repeat buyer of validators.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor news posts and elektronske-vozovnice pages; cross-check buyer name 'JAVNO PODJETJE MARPROM' on enarocanje.si for validator/acquiring contracts.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search on seed query
queries_used: Marprom Maribor javno naročilo kartični sistem avtobus vozovnice razpis

candidates.source_name: Racunsko sodisce RS - municipal audit reports (revizijska porocila obcin)
candidates.why_relevant: Supreme audit institution publishes per-auditee reports on municipalities (MOL among them) covering correctness and efficiency of operations, including procurement compliance and cash/financial management. Reports name systems, contracts and irregularities that notices never disclose.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the seznam revidirancev (auditee list) filtered to obcine and javna podjetja; download report PDFs and full-text index for payments/banking terms.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search
queries_used: Računsko sodišče revizijsko poročilo občina poslovanje revizije objave iskalnik

candidates.source_name: UKC Ljubljana - Javne objave in narocila (incl. evidencna narocila)
candidates.why_relevant: Largest Slovenian javni zavod buyer. Its 'evidencna narocila' sub-page publishes the small-value procurements (below notice threshold) where POS terminals, card readers for patient co-payments and kiosk payment systems typically sit - invisible on enarocanje.si.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the evidencna_narocila and javno_zbiranje_ponudb directories; note legacy index.php?dir= URL scheme is scrape-friendly but fragile to site redesign.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search
queries_used: UKC Ljubljana javna naročila

candidates.source_name: UKC Maribor - Javna narocila
candidates.why_relevant: Second university medical centre; independent buyer of facility, kiosk and payment-acceptance equipment alongside its clinical procurement. Regional counterpart to UKC Ljubljana in the cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the obvestila/javna-narocila listing on a weekly cadence and filter by Slovene payments keywords.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search

UKC Ljubljana javna naročila

candidates.source_name: Splosna bolnisnica Celje - Javne objave in javna narocila / Evidencne objave
candidates.why_relevant: Representative regional general hospital (splosna bolnisnica) publishing both formal and evidencna procurement; the evidencna stream is where small payment-acceptance and kiosk purchases appear. Its annual report PDFs additionally disclose banking relationships and cash-handling arrangements.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape evidencna-narocila listing; also parse annual letno porocilo PDFs for banking/payment-cost line items. Use the same URL pattern to probe the other ~10 splosne bolnisnice.

candidates.source_name: TED - Tenders Electronic Daily (Slovenia, local authority buyers)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory EU-level publication for above-threshold contracts. Large municipal ticketing/parking-system and multi-year banking-service contracts cross the threshold and appear here with structured eForms fields and English translation - the cleanest machine-readable layer over the Slovene-only national notices.
candidates.access_status: public, free, with API and bulk downloads
candidates.legal_status: official EU publication, explicitly free to reuse
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED search API with country=SI, buyer type = regional/local authority or body governed by public law, filtered by CPV (30144200 ticket-issuing, 30123600 coin-handling, 34996300 parking control, 66110000 banking, 30162000/30142000 terminals). Prefer eForms XML notice packages over HTML.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en-language web search
queries_used: TED tenders electronic daily Slovenia municipality contract notice payment terminals ticketing

candidates.source_name: javnirazpisi.com - tender aggregator with per-authority pages
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that maintains per-contracting-authority landing pages (e.g. an organization/authority/12190 page for MESTNA OBCINA KRANJ) and regional filters (e.g. Jugovzhodna Slovenija). Excellent for enumerating the long tail of obcine and javni zavodi as buyers - use as an actor-discovery pointer, not as a primary content source.
candidates.access_status: partly free listing, likely paywalled/registration for full content
candidates.legal_status: commercial site; ToS likely restricts systematic scraping - verify before automated collection
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume use for actor enumeration and CPV-taxonomy hints only; do not bulk-scrape. Resolve every lead back to enarocanje.si or the buyer's own site for the authoritative record.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search; appeared as third-party index of municipal buyers

candidates.why_relevant: Second Slovene commercial aggregator with a 'javna nabava' index; useful cross-check for coverage of the national portal and for spotting notice categories/taxonomies. Pointer value only.
candidates.access_status: public listing, likely subscription for detail

candidates.why_relevant: White-labelled SaaS portal that Maribor uses to run and publish its own calls, with structured application flows. Shows that some obcine outsource their tender front-end - a pattern worth detecting across other municipalities, since these portals hold documents the main site does not.
candidates.legal_status: third-party platform hosting official municipal content
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the public call listing; probe for other <obcina>.tendee.net subdomains to enumerate additional municipal buyers using the same platform.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search; snowballed from Maribor municipal results
queries_used: Mestna občina Maribor javna naročila portal

candidates.source_name: Skupnost obcin Slovenije (SOS) - joint municipal procurement
candidates.why_relevant: Largest representative association of Slovenian municipalities; runs SKUPNO JAVNO NAROCANJE (joint procurement) on behalf of member obcine and javni zavodi, and maintains a full member directory - the canonical actor map for this cell. Its 'javna narocila' category carries announcements of aggregated procurements, a channel that can bundle many small municipal payment needs into one large contract.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest the /obcine/ member directory once to seed the actor map, then monitor the javna-narocila and javna-uprava topic feeds; the 2023 archive at arhiv2023.skupnostobcin.si holds the historical category.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search
queries_used: Skupnost občin Slovenije javna naročila

candidates.source_name: Zdruzenje obcin Slovenije (ZOS)
candidates.why_relevant: Second municipal association, with a different (largely smaller-municipality) membership than SOS. Publishes news on transparency and administrative tooling for obcine (e.g. covered the ERAR relaunch) and complements the SOS member directory for full actor coverage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest member list and monitor news feed at low frequency.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search, snowballed from ERAR query
queries_used: ERAR erar.si transakcije javnega sektorja občine plačila iskalnik

candidates.source_name: Uradni list RS - javni razpisi section
candidates.why_relevant: Official gazette; municipalities publish certain javni razpisi (co-financing calls, some procurement-adjacent notices) here rather than on their own sites - confirmed for Mestna obcina Koper. Also the publisher/operator behind the Portal javnih narocil.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape or search the glasilo issue index filtered to 'Javni razpisi' rubric and obcina publisher names; stable per-item URLs under /glasilo-uradni-list-rs/vsebina/.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search, snowballed from Koper

candidates.source_name: OPSI - Odprti podatki Slovenije (podatki.gov.si)
candidates.why_relevant: National open-data portal that republishes procurement- and spend-relevant datasets in machine-readable form, including the ERAR public-money dataset (ZIntPK 75.a/75.b cash-flow evidence). The preferred legal and technical route to bulk data instead of scraping the ERAR or portal UIs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the CKAN-style API to discover datasets tagged javna narocila / obcine / erar, then pull resource files on a schedule.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search, snowballed from ERAR
queries_used: ERAR erar.si transakcije javnega sektorja občine plačila iskalnik

candidates.source_name: UJP - Uprava RS za javna placila
candidates.why_relevant: Structurally decisive for the 'municipal banking' topic: direct and indirect users of municipal budgets hold their accounts through UJP under a Ministry of Finance rulebook, not through freely tendered commercial bank relationships. This constrains where obcina banking-services tenders can exist at all, and redirects the addressable opportunity toward acquiring, cash handling and payment acceptance rather than account management.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read the Pravilnik on account management for direct/indirect users of state and municipal budgets to scope which banking services are and are not tenderable; monitor UJP for rule changes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search on municipal banking seed query
queries_used: občina javno naročilo "vodenje transakcijskih računov" banka storitve razpis

candidates.source_name: Obcina Novo mesto / Skofja Loka parking-payment pages (municipal payment-method disclosures)
candidates.why_relevant: Mid-size obcine publish operational notices naming their actual parking-payment vendors and schemes (Sitium app in Novo mesto; EasyPark SMS parking with a new short number from 1 Mar 2025). These pages are the cheapest way to detect vendor switches - each switch implies a preceding or forthcoming procurement.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Maintain a watchlist of parking/mobility pages across all mestne obcine and larger obcine; diff page text on a monthly cadence and alert on vendor-name or payment-method changes. Pair each detected change with an enarocanje.si buyer-name lookup.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language seed query; snowballed across several obcine
queries_used: občina javno naročilo brezstično plačevanje parkirnine razpis

candidates.source_name: IJPP - Integrirani javni potniski promet (national unified ticketing scheme)
candidates.why_relevant: The national contactless-smartcard ticketing scheme that municipal urban operators (LPP, Marprom) must interoperate with; Maribor explicitly consolidated its urban and IJPP validators into one reader. Scheme-level changes and ministry RFIs cascade into municipal validator and acceptance procurement. A published English RFI invitation on gov.si confirms the ministry solicits market input on JPP systems.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the Ministry (MOPE / infrastructure) JPP pages for RFI/RFP documents and scheme specification updates; cross-reference with operator sites (arriva.si, potniski.sz.si, ap-ljubljana.si) which publish scheme-side ticketing changes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl+en web search
queries_used: IJPP integriran javni potniški promet enotna vozovnica javno naročilo sistem plačevanja Slovenija

negative_findings.description: Targeted Slovene searches for a municipal tender specifically procuring contactless parking-fee payment (obcina javno narocilo brezsticno placevanje parkirnine razpis) returned only operational parking pages and ordinances, never a notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: General web search does not index individual notice bodies on enarocanje.si well enough to surface subject-matter tenders. Only the deployed outcome (Sitium, EasyPark, Urbana, Valu) is visible on the open web, not the procurement that produced it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that keyword discovery for this cell must run INSIDE the portal's own search and inside DKOM/ERAR, not through general search engines. A collection design relying on Google-style discovery would systematically miss the tenders.

negative_findings.description: Slovene search for hospital/javni zavod POS-terminal tenders returned no specific hospital notice for payment terminals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results were generic portal and aggregator pages plus unrelated hospital tenders (cleaning, insurance, cleaning robots). No payments-acceptance tender for a Slovenian hospital was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests hospital card-acceptance is either bundled into acquiring contracts arranged outside the notice threshold, or sits in evidencna narocila lists that are published as PDFs on individual hospital sites. Collection must target evidencna narocila pages, not just the national portal.

negative_findings.description: Slovene search for municipal tenders on 'vodenje transakcijskih racunov' (transaction-account management) found no municipal banking-services tender at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: Instead the results consistently point to UJP and the Ministry of Finance rulebooks governing accounts of direct and indirect users of municipal budgets, and to AJPES's register of transaction accounts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'municipal cash management / banking services' topic in this cell's rationale may be largely non-tenderable in Slovenia because account management is centralised through UJP. The addressable municipal banking opportunity is more likely acquiring, cash-in-transit and payment acceptance. This should be validated before allocating collection effort.

negative_findings.description: No candidate URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all were observed as search-result links only.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are recorded with confidence scores reflecting how consistently they appeared across independent searches, not reachability.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve every URL. Legacy patterns (kclj.si index.php?dir=, arhiv2023.skupnostobcin.si) and JSF-stateful pages (ejn.gov.si .xhtml) are the most likely to fail naive GET checks while still being live.

negative_findings.description: The two commercial Slovene aggregators (javnirazpisi.com, javni-razpisi.si) were identified but their paywall, registration and terms-of-service status were not established.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as pointer sources with collection_allowed=false pending a ToS review.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Using them for systematic collection without checking terms would be a legal exposure; their real value here is actor enumeration, which can be done manually and at low volume.

coverage_gaps.description: Only 5 mestne obcine (Ljubljana, Maribor, Celje, Kranj, Koper) plus Novo mesto and Skofja Loka were reached. Slovenia has 212 obcine including 12 mestne obcine; Nova Gorica, Ptuj, Murska Sobota, Velenje, Slovenj Gradec, Krsko and Domzale were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the full member directory from skupnostobcin.si/obcine/ and ZOS, then auto-probe each domain for the standard Slovene procurement path patterns (/javna-narocila, /javni-razpisi, /razpisi, /informacije-javnega-znacaja) and for the ZJN-3 annual awarded-contract list.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal utilities beyond transport and parking were not investigated: water/waste (VOKA Snaga, Komunala), energy (Energetika Ljubljana), sports and culture javni zavodi, and municipal libraries - all of which take counter and kiosk payments and issue cards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate javna podjetja and javni zavodi per municipality (via ERAR payer lists and AJPES) and add their procurement pages to the watchlist; the Urbana card already spans libraries, proving cross-zavod acceptance.

coverage_gaps.description: No notice-level search interface or API for enarocanje.si was located; it is unclear whether structured/eForms exports exist for below-EU-threshold Slovene notices, which is precisely the band where municipal payments purchases live.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate wwwpjn2.enarocanje.si and the eForms migration for an OCDS/XML feed or a documented search endpoint before committing to HTML scraping. Check whether the Open Contracting / OpenTender Europe publication includes below-threshold SI notices.

coverage_gaps.description: The glossary for acquiring-side vocabulary in Slovene municipal procurement was only partially built. Terms confirmed in use: plačilni terminal, POS, kartični sistem, brezstična kartica, čitalnik vozovnic, parkomat, urbanomat, evidenčno naročilo, letni seznam oddanih javnih naročil, Valú. Not yet validated: 'pridobivanje kartičnih plačil', 'sprejemanje plačilnih kartic', 'kartično poslovanje', 'gotovinsko poslovanje', 'blagajniško poslovanje', 'e-vozovnica', 'validator', 'account-based ticketing' in Slovene usage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a term-mining pass over 30-50 confirmed municipal notices and DKOM decisions to extract the actual noun phrases buyers use, then rebuild the keyword set from observed usage rather than from translation.

coverage_gaps.description: Italian and Hungarian bilingual municipalities were not covered in their minority languages. Koper/Capodistria, Izola/Isola, Piran/Pirano publish in Italian, and Lendava/Lendva in Hungarian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Italian ('appalto pubblico', 'bando di gara', 'terminali di pagamento') and Hungarian ('közbeszerzés', 'pályázat') query variants for the bilingual coastal and Prekmurje municipalities.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical/archival dimension was established. Only Kranj was confirmed to publish a procurement archive; the retention policy of enarocanje.si notices and of DKOM decisions was not checked.

brief: Slovenian local-government payments procurement is a two-layer landscape: a mandatory national spine (enarocanje.si for all notices under ZJN-3, ejn.gov.si for bid submission, TED for above-threshold contracts) sitting over ~212 municipal and public-institution websites that publish, in Slovene only, the below-threshold 'evidencna narocila' and the ZJN-3 annual awarded-contract lists where most POS, validator and parking-terminal purchases actually live. The highest-yield sources for this cell are indirect rather than direct: DKOM review decisions expose full technical specs, bidders and prices for contested municipal payment procurements (confirmed case 018-027/2024 on LPT's 'Nakup parkirnih sistemov'), while ERAR reveals actual supplier payments from every obcina and javno podjetje below any notice threshold. The concrete buyer set is small and identifiable - MOL/Javni holding Ljubljana with the Urbana card across transit, parking and libraries; Maribor/Marprom, which went open-loop on Visa/Mastercard and mobile wallets in December 2024; LPT's parkomat and urbanomat estate; plus UKC Ljubljana, UKC Maribor and the splosne bolnisnice. One structural caveat materially reshapes the 'municipal banking' half of this cell: account management for municipal budget users is centralised through UJP rather than tendered to commercial banks, so the tenderable opportunity concentrates in acquiring, ticketing and cash-handling rather than transaction-account services.
